categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Jibeier Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. primarily engages in pharmaceutical research, development, and manufacturing. Its product portfolio includes tablets, capsules, and eye drops targeting multiple therapeutic areas such as leukocyte enhancement, hypertension, immune enhancement, joint diseases, eye infections, bronchitis, and liver protection. The company is also actively developing innovative drugs for depression, tumors, and gastrointestinal diseases.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced compound formulation technologies, deuterated drug development, and liposome drug delivery platforms. It has proprietary synthesis and quality control methods for key products like Likojun tablets and Niqunluo tablets, supported by multiple patents. Production strictly follows GMP standards with a focus on quality assurance, process optimization, and safety management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jibeier serves hospitals, retail pharmacies, and healthcare providers across China. Its products are used in various clinical departments including oncology, cardiology, endocrinology, infectious diseases, and pediatrics. Key markets include treatment of leukopenia, hypertension with tachycardia, inflammatory diseases, and eye infections.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with sales coverage spanning major regions including East China, Central China, Southwest, North China, South China, Northeast, and Northwest. It has established a nationwide marketing and distribution network with regional offices to support market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jibeier operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on drug research, development, manufacturing, and distribution. It procures raw materials and packaging from qualified suppliers and sells finished pharmaceutical products to hospitals and pharmacies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in drug development, focusing on high-impact therapeutic areas such as oncology, depression, cardiovascular, and metabolic diseases. It invests heavily in R&D, with ongoing clinical trials for novel compounds including deuterated antidepressants and liposomal anti-tumor drugs. Collaborations with academic institutions and CROs enhance its innovation capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of pharmaceutical products including tablets, capsules, and eye drops. The company employs an academic promotion plus pharmaceutical distributor sales model, leveraging expert networks and academic marketing to drive product adoption in hospitals and retail channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jibeier is positioned as a high-tech pharmaceutical manufacturer with a strong focus on innovative drugs. It holds leading market positions in niche segments such as leukocyte-enhancing drugs and compound antihypertensive medications. Its patented products like Niqunluo tablets have no generic competition domestically, providing competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 896.5 million, a 4.14% increase year-over-year, and net profits attributable to shareholders of RMB 219.3 million, stable compared to the prior year. Total assets grew by 14.39% to RMB 2.53 billion, and net assets increased by 18.05% to RMB 2.25 billion. R&D investment rose by 26.25% to RMB 70.4 million, representing 7.85% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jibeier emphasizes high-quality, innovative pharmaceutical products with strong clinical efficacy and safety profiles. Its proprietary technologies, such as deuterated drug synthesis and liposome formulations, extend drug half-life and reduce side effects. The company’s products are recognized in national medical insurance catalogs and clinical guidelines, underscoring their therapeutic value and market exclusivity.
